name: DAIHEN Corporation
summary: DAIHEN Corporation manufactures, sells, and repairs plasma generation power supplies in Japan. The company operates through Energy Management, Factory Automation, and Material Processing segments. The company offers transformers, welding machines, and power sources. It also offers distribution equipment, power distribution equipment, solar inverters, and others; and welding/cutting machines, such as CO2/MAG, TIG, MIG, DC/AC, plasma welding and cutting, submerged arc, and resistance welding machines, as well as welding and cutting torches, peripheral devices for welding, thermal spray machines, and welding accessories.
